name: HiCMAE (Hierarchical Contrastive Masked Autoencoder)
authors_or_creators: Licai Sun, Zheng Lian, Bin Liu, Jianhua Tao (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Tsinghua University)
backbone: Hierarchical dual-branch Transformer (Video ViT for visual stream + Audio ViT for audio stream, with cross-modal fusion blocks)
accuracy_affectnet: not reported (model targets audio-visual dynamic emotion benchmarks) [uncertain]
pretrained_weights_available: yes - released on the official GitHub repository
hardware_requirements: Pretraining on multiple NVIDIA A100 GPUs; finetuning feasible on a single high-memory GPU [uncertain]
loss_function: Combined objective: (1) masked reconstruction loss (MSE) on visual and audio modalities, (2) intra-modal contrastive loss, and (3) cross-modal (inter-modal) contrastive loss applied at multiple hierarchical levels; cross-entropy for downstream classification
training_data_used: Pretraining: large-scale audio-visual face/voice corpus (VoxCeleb2 audio+visual, ~1M clips). Finetuning: MAFW, DFEW, MER2023, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, MSP-IMPROV, IEMOCAP and similar audio-visual emotion datasets
pretraining_strategy: self-supervised (masked autoencoding combined with hierarchical multi-level contrastive learning across audio and visual modalities)
input_modality: audio-visual (synchronized face video + speech audio / mel-spectrogram)
dynamic_fer_metrics: MAFW (audio-visual): UAR ~42.65 / WAR ~56.17; DFEW (audio-visual): UAR ~63.76 / WAR ~75.01; MER2023 strong results reported [uncertain]
abaw_metrics: not the primary benchmark; not extensively reported on ABAW [uncertain]
cross_dataset_generalization: Reported transfer across MAFW/DFEW/CREMA-D/RAVDESS after single audio-visual pretraining [uncertain]
robustness: not specifically evaluated on Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB; some modality-dropout robustness analysis discussed [uncertain]
explainability: Attention visualizations across audio and visual streams discussed in paper
